summary: Checked 44 picks from about 40 X accounts against the books and ESPN game logs. Added only picks where both agree, or where the stats are strong and the price is close.
Added: Caleb Williams More 215.5 pass yds (Taco, 67%, full payout), Henderson More 30.5 rush+rec yds (57%), Gordon More 22 PRA (55.8%).
Stats picks (STATS, 52–53% on price): Jaylen Brown More 23.5 pts+asts (71 of 81 last season), Embiid More 3.5 assists (8 of last 10).
Removed: Mobley More 17.5 pts (4 of last 10, 1 of 4 vs PHI), Swift More 2.5 recs (3 of 6 this season), Jalen Williams and Murray rebounds (repriced below 54%).
Cavs: Jarrett Allen is questionable (knee). Bears: Kyle Monangai is out.
